fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole minivan, a vehicle we can detail.
findings: Yellowed, hazy headlight lenses on both front headlights
Dull, flat-looking silver paint on the hood and front fenders

message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Town and Country. The headlights look pretty yellowed and the paint on the hood is a bit flat in the photos, both things a detail can freshen up. We do mobile pre-sale details, including headlight restoration and a buff, and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
